# v2 adjudication log
Header notes:
(a) Labeller B2's environment leak: B2 ran in a live Claude Code session under sterling-main's own repo, so Sterling's H19/H23 knowledge-delivery hooks fired on B2's own file reads during labelling (e.g. reading scripts/hooks/lib/delivery.mjs itself triggered delivery pointers). B2 saw some delivered POINTERS as a side effect of its own tool calls, but never saw retrieval output, gold labels, or A's labels -- so this is a partial environment leak of the kind of information a real consuming agent would see (which is itself informative for a 'consumer judges quality' benchmark), not a leak of the answer key.
(b) Phase 1 (the 30 repaired cases) was rerun in an isolated folder after an earlier adjudicator session had seen labeller B's generator script (write-labels.mjs), which risked biasing that labelling; B2's blind labels used here were produced fresh, in isolation, from case text and knowledge_get on the records only.

## Re-adjudications (case | Sol | Claude | final | reason)

- **v2-a-pull-p-011** (2026-09-22; blind per decision knowledge-quality-replay-benchmark — Sol gpt-5.6-sol and a Claude sonnet researcher each labelled from a 1,564-record dump of the Dome Farmer store, neither seeing retrieval output or the prior label) | Sol: e01732d5:substance; 5426922a:substance; ea777ce9:substance; 8be3efe4:substance; 3eb1a5b1:pointer; acceptable c535f963; irrelevant 1dee0881, 99790a34, 367ae64f | Claude: e01732d5:substance; ea777ce9:substance; 3eb1a5b1:pointer; acceptable 1dee0881, 465c9eb9, 5e270264, 50e14ac1, c7aa6a9c; irrelevant 33a33dec, 98374cd5, e16ad980 | FINAL: e01732d5:substance; ea777ce9:substance; 3eb1a5b1:pointer; acceptable 5426922a, 8be3efe4, 1dee0881, c535f963, 465c9eb9, c7aa6a9c; irrelevant 99790a34, 367ae64f, 33a33dec, 98374cd5, e16ad980 | Both read "credits" as the in-game coop treasury+wallet currency (no end-credits roll exists in the corpus; the earlier rationale "cooperative completion presentation" misdescribed it) and "when shown" as HUD display timing. Agreed required: the coop-credits ruling (what the credits ARE), the station-console article (the live FarmConsole file chain and peacetime gate — without it an engineer edits a retired file), the farm-HUD/mech-HUD separation ruling as the baseline WHEN. Sol's extra required (farm-sync's economy wire section; the trade window's CREDITS readout and its hide-FarmConsole rule) ruled ACCEPTABLE: the change is HUD display timing, neither would make the engineer build the wrong thing, neither is noise. FarmChrome 1dee0881 ruled ACCEPTABLE over Sol's irrelevant: it is the only record of the WALLET column beside CREDITS (a Dome Farmer store gap, noted on board 58eaafa5). Irrelevant is the union of both lanes. Measured effect at b7e675a: Dome Farmer required 35 → 37, hits unchanged; p-011 stays 0/3 — preflight returns nothing ("cooperative" never meets "COOP"; "shown"/"credits" live only in bodies), so it is a vocabulary miss.

## Negative preflight cases (authored 2026-09-22, blind, cross-validated)

Until 2026-09-22 the v2 set had no negative preflight case, so the verdict cost of any preflight floor change (a true 'ungoverned' turning into a false 'verify_targets') was unmeasured (finding f6ada94d). Per decision knowledge-quality-replay-benchmark, Sol (gpt-5.6-sol) and a Claude sonnet researcher each proposed 8 negative requests from a 1,564-record dump of the Dome Farmer store, then each validated the OTHER lane's 8 blind. The conductor kept only candidates BOTH lanes confirmed and dropped anything either lane found governed or borderline.

- **KEPT as v2-a-pull-p-013 … p-020** (8): controller rumble on damage; coop text-chat window; cosmetic license plate per mech; Veskari bestiary in the garage; coop emote wheel; pet dog that barks at breach start (proposed independently by both lanes; merged); farm mailbox with settler letters; photo mode with free camera. Each case's `irrelevant` names the closest non-governing record so a return of it counts as noise.
- **DROPPED as GOVERNED** (Sol found a ruling the Claude lane missed): mech livery/paint customization — decision 59ae05e3 "ONE COLOURWAY REPAINTS THE WHOLE MACHINE"; player-to-player mech sales for credits — decision 5793a956 "any future exchange of goods, parts or credits happen at the TRADER and nowhere else".
- **DROPPED as BORDERLINE** (one lane governed, one negative, or the same lane split on phrasing): colour-blind HUD palette / colour-blind alert colours — HUD article 5f2dd65e "DomeTheme has no alert colour and inventing one starts a second palette" constrains alert colours and arguably a second palette (Sol called its own palette phrasing negative and the Claude lane's alert-colour phrasing governed); achievements for surviving ten breaches — decision 2e815b6a stops breach scheduling after five, so the example milestone cannot occur; crop-insurance refund at the trader — decision 7bbdef3f makes crops become credits only through trader sales (weak, but a conductor would want it surfaced); fishing minigame with a pond — decision bf964238 rejected the pond-bearing landscape option (Sol first rejected its own pond candidate on it, then confirmed the Claude lane's single-pond minigame as ungoverned).
- **Rejected by their own authors before exchange** (governing record named): manual saves during a breach (5a852f0f), cockpit building health bars (550a84ae), garage shop (5793a956), coop callsigns (3f8676d6), garage jukebox (8eee51bb), timed trader auctions (6660416b), gamepad support (f7abd2fe), weather crop damage (b6d84394 / fb68d6fb).
